question: What was total revenue by year?

question: How many orders were placed each year?

reference.sql: SELECT metric_time__year, COUNT(DISTINCT __orders) AS orders FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_purchase_date) AS metric_time__year, CASE WHEN is_revenue_order THEN order_id END AS __orders FROM "fct_orders" AS fct_orders_src_10000) AS subq_3 GROUP BY metric_time__year LIMIT 100

question: What was the average order value by year?

reference.sql: SELECT metric_time__year, CAST(revenue AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(orders, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS aov FROM (SELECT COALESCE(subq_5.metric_time__year, subq_11.metric_time__year) AS metric_time__year, MAX(subq_5.revenue) AS revenue, MAX(subq_11.orders) AS orders FROM (SELECT metric_time__year, SUM(__revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_purchase_date) AS metric_time__year, CASE WHEN is_revenue_order THEN item_revenue ELSE 0 END AS __revenue FROM "fct_order_items" AS fct_order_items_src_10000) AS subq_3 GROUP BY metric_time__year) AS subq_5 FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT metric_time__year, COUNT(DISTINCT __orders) AS orders FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', order_purchase_date) AS metric_time__year, CASE WHEN is_revenue_order THEN order_id END AS __orders FROM "fct_orders" AS fct_orders_src_10000) AS subq_9 GROUP BY metric_time__year) AS subq_11 ON subq_5.metric_time__year = subq_11.metric_time__year GROUP BY COALESCE(subq_5.metric_time__year, subq_11.metric_time__year)) AS subq_12 LIMIT 100

question: What was the monthly average order value in 2018?

question: Which 5 customer states have the slowest average delivery time in hours?

args.sql: select customer_state, avg(purchase_to_customer_hours) as avg_hours from fct_orders o join dim_customer c using (customer_sk) where o.is_delivered group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 5

reference.sql: SELECT customer_state, AVG(purchase_to_customer_hours) AS avg_hours FROM fct_orders AS o JOIN dim_customer AS c USING (customer_sk) WHERE o.is_delivered GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average customer lifetime value (ltv) in the customer 360 report?

args.sql: select avg(ltv) as avg_ltv from rpt_customer_360

reference.sql: SELECT AVG(ltv) AS avg_ltv FROM rpt_customer_360 LIMIT 1000

question: How many customers placed their first order in 2017?

args.sql: select count(*) as customers from fct_orders where is_first_order and year(order_purchase_date) = 2017

reference.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM fct_orders WHERE is_first_order AND YEAR(order_purchase_date) = 2017 LIMIT 1000
